event.name: c. 3000 BC: Shahr-e Sukhteh is inhabited in southeastern Iran

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: Wikipedia and UNESCO differ on occupation endpoints but both support habitation around 3000 BCE. The Wikipedia article dates an end-of-phase fire around 3000 BCE, but its cited Encyclopaedia Iranica places that fire around 2700 BCE; no fire or exact-year founding is asserted.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: Approximate archaeological context; 3000 BCE is a gameplay reference, not a verified exact date.

event.name: c. 3000 BC: settlements exist in Peru’s Supe Valley, where Caral later becomes a major center

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: ICOMOS states Supe Valley settlements were occupied in 3000 BCE and distinguishes the organized capital zone around 2600 BCE. Wikipedia dates Caral itself approximately 2600–2000 BCE, while UNESCO uses 3000–1800 BCE for the site; therefore this note concerns the valley, not an exact 3000 BCE date for the city. The later Caral site is only a regional reference point.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: Approximate archaeological context; 3000 BCE is a gameplay reference, not a verified exact date.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Regional reference point and gameplay radius; not the culture or settlement boundary.
